about: Golden vectors for tools/persist_layout.py (persist_layout 2): `cases` = a LAYOUT-0 register file (TAU DEV 181 and older; words 0..31, only the non-zero ones listed) and the layout-2 register file the migration writes, with the values it held; `resume` = that migration interrupted after k writes (WRITE_ORDER, word 0 last) and what the next boot makes of it; `cases_v1` and `resume_v1` = the same for a LAYOUT-1 register file (TAU DEV 182 .. 219, v0.7.0, v0.7.1), (a power cut INSIDE a tuning slot's four writes loses that one tuning: `lost_tuning_slots`); whose selected meter index becomes the id hash of fw2/cores/shipped_meter_ids.h (PLACEHOLDER ids until P2.0) and whose tunings are re-keyed using `tune_max_fixture` (the largest value of each parameter of each shipped meter; a FIXTURE: the player reads the real ones). Generated by `python3 tools/persist_layout.py --golden`; checked against the firmware by sim/test_persist_layout.py.

cases.name: empty card (all zero: volume 0 is a valid legacy volume)
defaults of a fresh legacy card
a TAU DEV 181 card: volume 73, colour 7, meter 6
volume 100, repeat all, ReplayGain album, polarity light, Halcyon 30
every legacy field at its maximum
out-of-range legacy values read as defaults
a legacy tuning is dropped, last played kept
a legacy card whose meter index is not a shipped meter (14): selects nothing

cases_v1.name: meter 6 selected, nothing tuned, no preset (the owner's DEV 185 words 5 and 6 read this way)
meter 3 selected with preset position 9 and preset file id 20 (stored 21)
meter 6 selected with preset position 12 and preset file id 126 (stored 127)
meter 2 selected, tuned (slot A holds a layout-1 tuning of meter 2)
meter 6 selected, a tuning with nine parameters in slot B (some may not fit the shorter header)
selected index 11 is not a shipped meter: selects nothing, its tuning is dropped
